title: A finite independent family is bounded by cardinal dimension
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $V$ be an $F$-vector space of arbitrary dimension, let $n\in\mathbf N$, and let $v:\mathrm{Fin}\,n\to V$ be linearly independent, meaning that $\sum_{i\in\mathrm{Fin}\,n}a_iv_i=0$ for scalars $a_i\in F$ forces every $a_i=0$. Then $\operatorname{Cardinal.mk}(\mathrm{Fin}\,n)\le\dim_F V$, where $\dim_F V$ is cardinal-valued dimension, the cardinality of any Hamel basis, with no finite-dimensionality assumption.
